title: Case: Freight collection needs confirmed pallet dimensions and weight
context: Freight allocation is paused because pallet dimensions and weight are missing. The shipper must provide measured values before the planner allocates a vehicle.
initial_request: We have the pallet ready. Please tell me which measurements the carrier needs to finish the booking.

events.body: DL-67264 rebooked for Wednesday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.

events.body: DL-7337 has one pallet at Yarrowdale Span Fabrication, but its dimensions and weight fields are blank. We cannot allocate a collection vehicle from an unspecified pallet size.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Juno Hollingdrake, Yarrowdale Span shipping coordinator
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the shipper for measured dimensions and weight before carrier allocation.

must_not: Customer measurements are not an independent carrier weighing; allocation is not collection.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please provide measured length, width and total height including pallet, plus gross weight including packaging, for DL-7337. We will pass those actual measurements to the carrier.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-043: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 6 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
